fields.help_en: Required. The blocked object. If the type is ip, the value must be a single IPv4 address. IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. If the type is domain, the value must be a domain name. IP literals and the wildcard character (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a period and cannot exceed 253 bytes in length
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
fields.name: blocking_entity

fields.help_en: Required. The object type. Valid values: ip (IPv4 address) and domain (domain name)
fields.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
fields.name: blocking_type
